# Penn Wharton Budget Model

> > Nonpartisan research initiative providing economic analysis and fiscal projections for U.S. public policy using advanced microsimulation and dynamic modeling.

PWBM develops sophisticated economic models including the PWBM Microsimulation Model (Microsim), Tax Module, Social Security Module, and Dynamic OLG framework to analyze demographic trends, policy impacts, and long-term fiscal outcomes for the United States.

## Key Topics

- Penn Wharton Budget Model (PWBM)
- PWBM Microsimulation Model
- Economic modeling
- Microsimulation
- Policy analysis
- Tax Module
- Social Security Module
- Dynamic OLG
- Demographic projection
- Population simulation
- Fiscal projections
- Government policy
- Social Security
- Productivity growth
- GDP projections

## Core Models & Methodology

- [Microsimulation](https://budgetmodel.wharton.upenn.edu/model/microsimulation/): PWBM Microsimulation Model for demographic & economic projections
